title: External screen stays blank
description: Display worked when connected directly to the laptop.
resolution: Replaced the display cable between the dock and monitor.

title: Sign-in problem after a phone change
description: Employee could not use their previous authentication method.
resolution: Transferred the case to the account support team, which restored access after identity verification.

title: USB-C dock disconnects
description: Keyboard and monitor disconnected when the dock cable moved.
resolution: Confirmed the issue with a second dock and replaced the faulty dock.

title: Laptop will not start
description: No startup screen and no charging light when docked.
resolution: Tested with an approved charger directly. The laptop charged and started. A replacement dock cable resolved the original issue.

title: Loan laptop setup
description: The assigned laptop was sent for warranty service.
resolution: A loan was approved during staffed hours and returned on the agreed date.

title: New starter cannot sign in
description: New employee cannot access the support portal.
resolution: Account support corrected the account assignment.

title: Wi-Fi drops in meeting room
description: Connection is stable at the desk but drops in a meeting room.

title: Laptop charging is intermittent
description: Charger connects intermittently at the laptop port.
resolution: Confirmed the fault with a second compatible charger and scheduled a hardware inspection.

title: Laptop fails on Friday evening
description: Laptop stays off with an approved charger connected directly. Customer needs a loan laptop for Monday morning. No loan unit has been allocated.
